entities.name: Yahenni
entities.description: A flamboyant aetherborn investor, philanthropist and socialite of Ghirapur with weeks to live, narrator of the page, capable of essence draining but unwilling to use it.

entities.name: Depala
entities.description: A famed ace pilot and friend of Yahenni who owns a hyena and hints at essence draining as a way to extend life.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer and planeswalker seeking her captured mother Pia, who helps Yahenni melt a locked door.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker with all-green eyes, uneasy at parties, who senses the structure of Kaladesh and removes a Consulate enforcer.

entities.name: Oviya Pashiri
entities.description: A famous inventor and board game enthusiast who brings Chandra and Nissa to Yahenni's party.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: The most dangerous person in Ghirapur according to Yahenni, captured by the Consulate and held in Dhund.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: An officer stationed at Dhund Prison, where Pia is held.

entities.name: Aetherborn
entities.description: A short-lived, empathic race born from aether who live in Ghirapur and know how many days they have left.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: Kaladesh's government, whose enforcers jail aetherborn and renegades.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The city where aetherborn live and the Inventors' Fair is held.

entities.name: Dhund
entities.description: The Consulate prison where Pia Nalaar is held.

entities.name: Inventors' Fair
entities.description: The festival before which Yahenni throws a party and after which he plans a final one.

entities.name: Great Conduit
entities.description: A force Yahenni believes is present even in Ghirapur, which aetherborn embody.

entities.name: Essence draining
entities.description: A rare ability of Yahenni to steal life force from another being, which he refuses to use.

events.summary: Yahenni dresses for his party, knowing he has fifty-four days to live.
events.quote: I have fifty-four days left to live.

events.summary: Depala hints that Yahenni could extend his life by essence draining, and he refuses.
events.quote: I'm not willing to go those lengths, Depala.

events.summary: Mrs. Pashiri brings Chandra and Nissa to Yahenni's party.
events.quote: this is Chandra and Nissa

events.summary: Mrs. Pashiri tells Yahenni that Pia Nalaar has been captured and asks what he knows.
events.quote: Pia Nalaar was captured, you know.

events.summary: Yahenni admits he cannot say where the Consulate would hold a prisoner of Pia's standing.
events.quote: I don't know where the Consulate would take prisoners of Pia's standing.

events.summary: Chandra snaps that Yahenni would help if it were his parent.
events.quote: If it was your parent you'd help us,

events.summary: A dying aetherborn is carried in on a chair to attend their penultimate party.
events.quote: It's my penultimate party!

events.summary: Yahenni takes Nissa to the roof and explains that aetherborn are the city's own natural beings.
events.quote: We are the city. I'm made of aether, and one day, I'll return to it.

events.summary: Nissa senses that this world is structured and cyclical.
events.quote: This world is structured. Cyclical.

events.summary: A Consulate prison enforcer tries to force a bathroom door to seize a wanted convict.
events.quote: A wanted convict is currently barricaded behind that door.

events.summary: Yahenni offers Chandra and Nissa information in return for removing the enforcer and breaking the door.
events.quote: I'll give you the information you need if you'll help me.

events.summary: A potted plant coils around the enforcer's leg and he falls dazed.
events.quote: The potted plant by the door is inexplicably wrapped around the enforcer's leg

events.summary: Yahenni reads the enforcer's energy to learn Pia is held in Dhund prison.
events.quote: Dhund prison?

events.summary: Nissa carries the enforcer outside.
events.quote: easily hoists the man over her shoulders in a fireman's carry

events.summary: Chandra melts the lock of the bathroom door with a white-hot finger.
events.quote: quickly melts the locks with a white-hot finger to the metal

events.summary: Yahenni tells them Pia is at Dhund and Mrs. Pashiri warns that Baral is stationed there.
events.quote: Baral is stationed there.

events.summary: Chandra and Mrs. Pashiri leave at once to find Pia.
events.quote: We need to go now,

events.summary: Yahenni finds an escaped aetherborn convict dying in the bathroom with one minute left.
events.quote: I've got about a minute left,

events.summary: The dying aetherborn dies, their aether rising in vapor, after saying they had a good run.
events.quote: Their dermis crumbles and the contained aether escapes and rises in a gentle vapor to the ceiling.

events.summary: Yahenni finds the dead aetherborn was jailed for petty theft and is enraged at the Consulate.
events.quote: They shouldn't have been sent to prison in the first place.

events.summary: Yahenni considers hunting down the Consulate with essence draining but decides the time will come later.
events.quote: No. The time will come for that.

events.summary: Yahenni announces the party of a lifetime after the Inventors' Fair.
events.quote: I'm hosting the party of a lifetime here after the conclusion of the Inventors' Fair.

relations.note: Yahenni calls her a dear friend.
relations.quote: My dear friend and ace pilot Depala
That is Pia Nalaar's daughter, Chandra,

relations.note: He is stationed at the prison.
Pia is held in the prison.
relations.quote: Dhund Prison is where you'll find Pia,

relations.note: Yahenni says Consulate bastards are killing aetherborn faster.
relations.quote: Those Consulate bastards are just killing us faster.
